locations.label: Pack-a-Punch in lava
locations.description: Pack-a-Punch is already active in the central lava and costs 5,000. Save a slow zombie, let your health recover, approach by the shortest safe line and retrieve the weapon immediately. Have a teammate draw the last zombie away in co-op. There is no power switch or bank-door puzzle to complete. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Upstairs Jugger-Nog
locations.description: Find Jugger-Nog upstairs in the burning building, Quick Revive upstairs in the bar, Stamin-Up downstairs in the bar, Speed Cola inside the bank and Double Tap beside the outdoor Box location. Tombstone is in the street in co-op Survival. Solo Quick Revive costs 500 and supplies up to three self-revives; Tombstone is absent in solo. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
